alerts.application_rejected:
Update on {role} at {company}

{company} isn't taking your application forward for this drive, so please don't travel to it.
Your slot has been released.

Thank you for your interest. Other walk-ins near you are on the link below.
alerts.neverPay: Walkins never charges candidates, and no employer should ask you for money. If anyone does, report it here: {link}
alerts.drive_suspended:
Paused: {role} at {company}

This drive is paused while Walkins checks it. You haven't done anything wrong. Please don't travel to it for now. We'll message you here if it goes ahead, and holding this booking won't count against you.
alerts.messageFlagged: Warning: this message seems to ask for money. Walkins never charges candidates, and no employer should ask you to pay. Don't pay. Report it from the conversation on Walkins.
errors.checkIn.suspended: This drive is paused while Walkins checks it, so check-in is closed. You haven't done anything wrong. Please don't pay anyone at the venue for this job.
errors.application.suspended: This drive is paused while Walkins checks it, so it isn't taking bookings right now. You haven't done anything wrong. Other walk-ins near you are on the home page.
errors.messages.reportOwnSide: You can report messages from the other side of the conversation, not your own.
drive.detail.pausedBody: Walkins is checking this drive, so it isn't taking bookings and check-in is closed. If you booked a seat, you haven't done anything wrong, and holding it won't count against you. Please don't travel to it for now. If it goes ahead, everyone booked who hasn't checked in will be told.
drive.detail.unverified: This employer's documents are still waiting for Walkins to check them. It can run drives meanwhile, but never pay anyone for a job.
booking.noNeedToTravel: There's no need to travel to it. <link>Find other drives near you</link>
myDrives.outcome.awaitingConfirmation: Checked in, waiting for the employer to confirm
myDrives.noSeatHeld: No seat is held for you, so there's no need to travel to this one.
myDrives.paused: This drive is paused while Walkins checks it. You haven't done anything wrong. Please don't travel to it for now; you'll be told if it goes ahead, and this booking won't count against you.
myDrives.cancelled: The employer cancelled this drive, so please don't travel to it. This won't count against you.
myDrives.moved: The employer moved this drive. It was {day}, {time}.
myDrives.movedOffline: This drive has been moved before, and this copy was saved {day} at {time}. It may have moved again since. Check when you have signal before you travel.
checkin.flagged: The employer will confirm this check-in at the desk:
bot.neverPay: Walkins never charges candidates, and no employer should ask you for money. If anyone does, open that drive's link and tap Report.
neverPay.heading: Walkins never charges candidates
neverPay.body: No employer should ask you for money: not for registration, training, a uniform, a document or a job letter. If anyone does, don't pay.
neverPay.howToReport: If anyone asks you for money, open that drive's page and use Report this drive. You don't need to sign in.
report.drive.heading: Report this drive
report.drive.intro: Tell Walkins if something about this drive is wrong. You don't need an account, and the employer won't see who reported it.
report.drive.chooseReason: Choose what's wrong, then send the report.
report.drive.detailsHint: Up to 500 characters. Only Walkins reads this.
report.drive.thanks: Thank you. Walkins will look at this drive. If someone asked you for money, please don't pay them.
report.drive.failed: The report didn't go through. Check your signal and try again.
warning.heading: A notice from Walkins
warning.candidate: An employer reported a problem with your account: {reason, select, ASKS_FOR_MONEY {asking candidates for money} NOT_A_REAL_JOB {a job that isn't real} MISLEADING_PAY {pay that doesn't match the listing} ABUSIVE {abusive behaviour} FAKE_PROFILE {a profile that isn't genuine} other {something else}}. Nothing has changed, and you can keep booking walk-ins. This is a notice so you know.
thread.flaggedCandidate: This message seems to ask for money. Walkins never charges candidates, and no employer should ask you to pay. Don't pay. Report it below.
thread.report.failed: The report didn't go through. Try again.
yourRecord.state.awaitingConfirmation: you checked in; the employer hasn't confirmed it yet
yourRecord.state.notAttendedExcused: marked as not attending; this won't count against you
yourRecord.excused: The drive was moved after you booked, and the message saying when it moved to didn't reach you, so this won't count against you.
